title: RFQ 19DR8626Q0042 Generator Maintenance Solicitation

description_text: The Embassy of The United States of America in Santo Domingo is seeking responsible vendors to quote for Chancery Generator Maintenance Services, including . The Contractor shall provide preventive maintenance services for chancery building standby generator in accordance with the attached Statement of Work for the US Embassy Santo Domingo. The contractor shall ensure that all systems being serviced under this agreement are in good operational condition when activated.
